decisions.value: Projected 3D coordinates and depth-sorted primitives in Canvas2D, without a WebGL dependency. Orthographic and perspective projection, orbit, front/top/isometric views.
decisions.reason: Preview browser lacks WebGL; mathematical 3D rendering gives an actual consistent output everywhere. Bounded art renderer, not a full mesh modeling or physics engine.

decisions.value: At most eight emitter layers. Typed shape/motion/renderer modules, positions, color, lifetime envelope, additive/alpha blend, glow, sprite, seed ranges. JSON API shares validation with UI.

Device-local IndexedDB stores only explicitly saved generator recipes, at most 100 generators; each <=384KB including optional PNG <=256KB. Feed variant genomes embed immutable recipe for saved replay; no automatic frame/image disk writes.

Prism Lance, Ion Bloom, Arc Halo, Ember Wake, Cryo Shatter, Aurora Loom; independently registered stable generator IDs.
